# Luxe Beauty Yanchep

> Private lash and brow studio in Yanchep, Western Australia (WA 6035). Eyelash
> extensions, lash refills, tinting and brow shaping, by appointment, one client
> at a time. Serving Yanchep and the northern Perth corridor.

## Facts

- Business name: Luxe Beauty Yanchep

## Services and prices (AUD)

- Classic Lash Extensions: $120 - One extension per natural lash for defined, everyday length.
- Hybrid Lash Extensions: $140 - Classic extensions and volume fans mixed for texture and fullness.
- Volume Lash Extensions: $160 - Lightweight handmade fans for density and softness.
- Mega Volume Lash Extensions: $180 - Maximum density, still lightweight on the natural lash.
- Classic Two Week Refill: $60 - Maintains an existing classic set of extensions.
- Classic Three Week Refill: $75 - Maintains an existing classic set of extensions.
- Classic Foreign Lash Refill: $85 - Refilling another technician's work, including tidy-up.
- Hybrid Two Week Refill: $70 - Maintains an existing hybrid set of extensions.
- Hybrid Three Week Refill: $90 - Maintains an existing hybrid set of extensions.
- Hybrid Foreign Lash Refill: $100 - Refilling another technician's work, including tidy-up.
- Volume Two Week Refill: $80 - Maintains an existing volume set of extensions.
- Volume Three Week Refill: $100 - Maintains an existing volume set of extensions.
- Volume Foreign Lash Refill: $115 - Refilling another technician's work, including tidy-up.
- Mega Volume Two Week Refill: $90 - Maintains an existing mega volume set of extensions.
- Mega Volume Three Week Refill: $115 - Maintains an existing mega volume set of extensions.
- Mega Volume Foreign Lash Refill: $130 - Refilling another technician's work, including tidy-up.
- Lash Removal: $25 - Safe, gentle removal. Add-on to a lash set or refill.
- Lash Tint: $25 - Darkens fair lash tips. Add-on to a lash set or refill.
- Brow Shape: $25 - Shaping only. Add-on to a lash set or refill.
- Brow Shape and Tint: $40 - Shaped and tinted. Add-on to a lash set or refill.
- Brow Shape and Tint with Lash Tint: $60 - Brows shaped and tinted with a lash tint. Can be booked on its own.

## Common questions

- How much are lash extensions in Yanchep? A classic full set is $120, hybrid $140, volume $160, mega volume $180. Classic refills are $60 at two weeks or $75 at three weeks; refills for hybrid, volume and mega volume sets are priced in the same proportion to the full set.
- How long do lash extensions last? Individual extensions last the life of the natural lash they are attached to, six to eight weeks. A refill every two to three weeks keeps a set looking full.
- How long does a full set take? About two hours for classic, up to two and a half for volume or mega volume.
- Is a patch test needed? Yes, before a first appointment, at least 24 hours ahead and preferably 48.
- How much are brows? A brow shape is $25, or $40 with a tint, as an add-on to a lash set or refill. Lash tint and lash removal ($25 each) are add-ons too. Booked without lashes, a brow shape and tint with a lash tint is $60.
- Where is the studio? Yanchep, WA 6035. It is a private home studio; the exact address is sent on booking confirmation. Free parking.
- Can I swim with lash extensions? Yes, after the first 24 hours. Rinse with fresh water afterwards and keep oil-based sunscreen away from the lash line.
- When should I get lash extensions before a wedding? A trial set six to eight weeks before, then a final refill three to five days before the day.
